reference.title: Daemon self-restart, log discoverability, and orphan PID fix
reference.summary: Three daemon and session improvements in one session. First, the daemon now auto-restarts via syscall.Exec when a CLI/daemon version mismatch is detected — replacing the previous assumption that the CLI would restart it, which left the daemon dead. Second, ox daemon logs gained --path and --all flags for log-file discoverability and full log dump. Third, sessions running in Conductor environments were showing up as orphan because ox agent prime ran in a short-lived wrapper whose PID died immediately; the fix captures ParentPID via os.Getppid() at session-start time and self-heals stale PIDs on every hook fire. A debugging side-quest revealed that the session cache was split between ~/.cache/sageox/ and the macOS-native ~/Library/Caches/sageox/, which had been quietly complicating diagnostics. 6118 tests pass, 0 lint issues, PR opened.
key_actions: Added restartRequested field and RestartRequested() accessor to the Daemon struct
Implemented syscall.Exec self-restart in runDaemonForeground on version mismatch
Added --path and --all flags to ox daemon logs
Replaced stale prime-time ParentPID with os.Getppid() captured at session start
Added stale-PID self-healing on every hook fire to kill 'orphan' false positives
Discovered and reconciled the split session-cache paths on macOS
Verified with 6118 passing tests and 0 lint issues
